frozen_design_provenance.scope: The 48-case matrix, primary attempt-level estimand, Wilson interval, ordering, and stopping rule were first committed here before the extended matrix result was stored.
frozen_design_provenance.qualification: This is a retrospective frozen design, not a prospective preregistration. The present file contains later integrity metadata and analysis clarifications and is not claimed to be byte-for-byte untouched since first execution.

prior_observation_disclosure.observed_before_freeze: Thirteen of the 48 planned cells already had stored outcomes. A robustness report stored Ra=20000 seeds 0 through 11 (10 exact wins, 0 shortcut wins, 0 ties, 1 base-state failure, and 1 inconclusive action comparison). An earlier multi-amplitude single-state intervention separately stored an exact win at Ra=30000, seed=0, amplitude=0.025.

source_reports.scope: Ra=30000, seed 0, amplitude 0.025 row within a three-amplitude single-state report

prior_observation_disclosure.new_cells_at_freeze: The other 35 Ra/seed cells and the complete Ra-stratified matrix result were not stored before the frozen-design commit.
prior_observation_disclosure.interpretation: The full matrix is a frozen robustness extension of favourable prior evidence, not an untouched independent confirmation set. Results must report the overlap and may additionally separate previously observed from new cells.

integrity_amendments_after_freeze: Corrected the original 'preregistered' wording and replaced the placeholder lock time with the actual Git commit provenance.

Added strict case-evidence validation, numerical-equivalence handling, durable runner-failure semantics, and a cluster-aware seed bootstrap. The original attempt-level Wilson estimand is retained; the added bootstrap is explicitly secondary and post-freeze.

Corrected the prior-overlap count from 12 to 13 after identifying the Ra=30000, seed=0, amplitude=0.025 row in the earlier stored multi-amplitude intervention report; added explicit 13-cell versus 35-cell descriptive strata.

design.action_budget_definition: For each method, perturb the same count of raw-design cells by +amplitude and -amplitude. This is an equal zero-sum raw-design perturbation, not a claim of equal realised physical-density or wall-time budget.

analysis.hypothesis: the exact-gradient action wins more often than the shortcut action across comparable cases
analysis.primary_estimand: exact-gradient wins divided by comparable action pairs

outcome_numerical_equivalence.rule: Classify as a tie when abs(delta_J_shortcut - delta_J_exact) <= absolute_delta_J + relative_delta_J * max(abs(delta_J_exact), abs(delta_J_shortcut)).

secondary_estimands: exact-gradient wins divided by all attempted cases
comparable action pairs divided by all attempted cases
seed-cluster bootstrap interval for the pooled exact-win rate, resampling the 16 complete seed clusters across Rayleigh numbers
descriptive outcome summaries stratified into the 13 previously observed and 35 not-previously-stored cells

prior_observation_stratification.analysis_timing: added after the frozen design as a descriptive provenance amendment
prior_observation_stratification.estimands: Within each stratum, report planned, recorded, pending, outcome counts, comparable count, exact-win rate over comparable cases, exact-win rate over attempted cases, and comparability rate.
prior_observation_stratification.interpretation: This stratification exposes prior overlap; it does not convert the 35-cell stratum into a prospectively preregistered confirmation study.

cluster_aware_secondary.analysis_timing: added after the frozen design as a descriptive integrity amendment
cluster_aware_secondary.interval: two-sided percentile interval at the protocol confidence level
cluster_aware_secondary.incomplete_cluster_policy: Only seed clusters with a durable record at every planned Rayleigh number enter the bootstrap; report their count and whether all planned clusters are present.

sampling.seed_selection: fixed contiguous seeds 0 through 15 at every Rayleigh number
sampling.stopping_rule: run and report all 48 planned attempts; do not stop based on outcomes

failure_policy.base_not_converged: retain as a solver failure; exclude from the comparable-case denominator
failure_policy.inconclusive: retain as an action-comparison failure; exclude from the comparable-case denominator
failure_policy.runner_failure: retain as an orchestration failure; exclude from the comparable-case denominator and include in the all-attempt denominator
failure_policy.unexpected_execution_unit_exception: classify as runner_failure, never as an inconclusive scientific comparison
failure_policy.nonzero_exit_with_valid_report: use the report; intervention_robustness.py uses a nonzero exit when no comparison is available
failure_policy.resume: never rerun an attempt with a valid durable attempt record
failure_policy.ingestion: validate complete per-case evidence and recompute the outcome with the recorded tolerance before creating a durable matrix record; never trust a reported outcome label alone
